title: Narita betrays Shota Umino
summary: Two members of New Japan’s new generation form an uneasy tag team. Ren Narita chooses House of Torture and makes Shota Umino the first target of his new direction.

chapters.title: The tag team collapses
chapters.result: Narita attacks Umino and joins House of Torture.
chapters.context: The betrayal changes an uneasy partnership into a personal feud between rival representatives of the next generation.

chapters.title: House of Torture wins the Dome encounter
chapters.result: Narita and EVIL defeat Umino and Kiyomiya.
chapters.context: Interference helps Narita’s new faction deny Umino revenge on the biggest stage.
